faq.q: What is the best alternative to Rosebud?
faq.a: If you want one journal where everything connects, Auserene is the stronger pick. It connects quick notes, an evening conversation, a meditation made from your day, memory you can read and edit, people and habit goals, and it keeps a free plan. For analysis and frameworks, Mindsera. For a cheaper all-device option with guided journals, Reflection. For a long archive with optional AI, Day One. For free and private with no AI chat, Apple Journal.

faq.q: Is there a free alternative to Rosebud?
faq.a: Yes. Auserene's free plan has no time limit and covers notes, mood, habits, people and guided journeys, with the AI conversation on Premium. Reflection, Life Note and Mindsera have free plans with limited AI, Day One's free plan has no AI, and Apple Journal is free with no AI chat.

faq.q: Why did Rosebud get rid of its free plan?
faq.a: Rosebud's help center says it retired the free plan on September 30, 2026, because it is "unable to sustainably offer a free tier moving forward," tied to the cost of its new memory system. Existing entries stay and can be exported.

faq.q: What apps are like Rosebud journal?
faq.a: Apps like Rosebud include Auserene, Mindsera, Life Note, Reflection, Day One (with its Gold plan's Daily Chat), Stoic and Reflectly. All of them use AI to respond to or analyze your journal; they differ on memory, meditation, platforms and price. Auserene is the one where those features connect.

faq.q: Is there a Rosebud alternative with meditation?
faq.a: Auserene writes a guided meditation from each day's conversation, has eight guided meditation journeys, and does haptic breathing on Apple Watch. Stoic includes generic meditation and breathing exercises. Rosebud, Mindsera, Life Note, Reflection and Day One don't list meditation.

faq.q: Can I move my Rosebud journal to another app?
faq.a: Rosebud lets you export all entries as Markdown from its web app, and individual entries on web and mobile. Whether another app can import them depends on that app.

informationGain: A November 19, 2026 comparison of nine Rosebud alternatives where every competitor fact links to that company's own page, covering who still has a free plan after Rosebud retired its own, whose AI memory you can actually read and edit, which run on Android, and which include meditation, including the finding that none of the major AI journals makes a meditation from your entries.
